2445-4050-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-4050-5254.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Repeat.

2829-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

3899-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-6495-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-7060.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-3125-4050-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4050-7422.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

277-1308-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2178-5256-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1812-2440-4183-7747.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Giant-Sized Flying Ant
1812-2440-4183-7747.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant with haste.
When the token Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Giant-Sized Flying Ant trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Giant-Sized Flying Ant, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Giant-Sized Flying Ant for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

3197-5870-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-5870-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2292-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

141-2906-7302.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
141-2906-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Rakdos.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 3.

2308-4050-4871-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2308-4050-4871-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-6458.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Thunder of Unity triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat from step 2.

509-1267-5547-5776.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-5547-5776.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 4.

877-3504-6967.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Mercurial Pretender.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

775-1409-5921.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3417-6889.notablePrerequisites:
You control an indestructible creature with power 1 or greater.
You control another creature if the indestructible creature's power is greater than or equal to Howlpack Avenger's toughness, or if Howlpack Avenger is the aforementioned indestructible creature.
3417-6889.description:
Cast Pain for All by paying {2}{R}, attaching it to an indestructible creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When Pain for All enters, it triggers, causing the creature it's attached to to deal damage to another creature you control.
Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to the indestructible creature.
Howlpack Avenger and Pain for All trigger.
Resolve the Pain for All trigger, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing that much damage to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 4.

957-1987-4423-6927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4423-6927.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Damage Control Crew.
When Damage Control Crew and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your second extra turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1410-2390-2919.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give All Will Be One lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
1410-2390-2919.description:
Animate All Will Be One with Captain Rex Nebula.
Give All Will Be One lifelink.
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

539-2783-5649-6798.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-4927-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-4927-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3951-4094-5703-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4094-5703-6646.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3504-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Mercurial Pretender on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Mercurial Pretender do not have summoning sickness.
3504-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Mercurial Pretender.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Mercurial Pretender.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

282-2099-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2099-5365.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.
282-2099-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

349-1744-2836-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
349-1744-2836-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Cerulean Wisps by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Cerulean Wisps targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Cerulean Wisps, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

104-609-2060-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Mine Worker does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mine Worker.
104-609-2060-3525.description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

678-1003-1636-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1003-1636-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1765-2279-2287-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1765-2279-2287-5231.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Spirit and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {R}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

2713-3458-5010-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {R}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Impromptu Raid by paying {R/G}, revealing Golgari Thug from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

436-4050-4772-5003-5296.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ao, adding one mana of any color.
Ao dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ao trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature and Vehicle you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ao from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1608-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triplicate Titan, adding {C}{C}.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Triplicate Titan trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

225-539-3177-5233.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4893-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
2457-4289-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

890-1978-2713.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.
